claim: Patchline ships an industry working-group charter with named member organizations and meeting minutes. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the working-group claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make industry-working-group-gate`.
